description.title: About me
description.heading: My name is Dominik Pokorny
paragraphs: I am a personal masseur for men, a chef, and an athlete.
I know what it feels like when someone works hard for weeks, deals with life stress, and fatigue keeps building up.
That is exactly why I started massaging and creating a safe space where people can pause and truly breathe.
I help bring back lightness to the body, joy of movement, and most importantly peace of mind.
Because everyone needs to release accumulated stress and inner tension and feel real relief.
points: I focus on quality, not quantity — maximum two clients per day
I come directly to your home, no commuting or parking stress
Every treatment is adjusted to your needs, boundaries, and current condition

services.title: Finnish massage
paragraphs: Traditional Finnish massage adjusted to the intensity you prefer.
It can be very gentle and relaxing, or properly deep and strong. Always based on what you want right now.

services.title: Trigger points
paragraphs: Every massage also includes palpation of treated areas to identify blocked muscles that may benefit from pressure treatment.
This release work can be intense in the short term, but it often brings significant long-term pain relief and restores mobility.
Trigger point release is always done only after communication with you and in line with your preference.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything important before booking in one place.

items.question: Do I need to prepare for the massage?
answer: Only three things are needed: fill in the questionnaire honestly before choosing a time, avoid heavy food at least one hour before massage, and plan the next day to be less physically demanding.
No other special preparation is required from your side, I take care of the rest.

items.question: Do I have to be naked during massage?
answer: I respect client boundaries and maintain maximum discretion regarding intimacy and private areas.
The usual standard is wearing underwear, with clean sheet coverage so parts not being treated stay discreetly covered.

items.question: Do you massage women as well?
items.answer: For personal reasons, I currently work exclusively with male clients.

items.question: Does it hurt?
answer: It depends on your preference and expectations.
If you want a light relaxation massage, it should not hurt. If you prefer deeper work or releasing tight spots, it can be more intense, but it often helps the body significantly in the long term.

items.question: How does it work?
answer: I come to your home (or your own environment), bring all equipment, and create a calm recovery zone right where you already are.
This includes a heated table pad, oil warmer, scented candles, and relaxing tea.
After a short consultation we start the massage, and once finished I pack everything and you can continue resting. I strongly recommend a lighter schedule on the following day.

items.question: Why choose my services?
items.answer: Because I focus on quality, not quantity. I work with a maximum of two clients per day so I can give each person full attention, and everything happens at your home without unnecessary travel.
